facts.fact: Quarterly revenue was $109.4 billion, up 16 percent year over year, a June quarter record.
facts.quote: The Company posted quarterly revenue of $109.4 billion, up 16 percent year over year.
facts.location: opening paragraph under the headline; total net sales row of the statement of operations
common_errors: using the nine-month total net sales of $364,357 million as the quarter
calling it Q2 or calendar Q3 instead of fiscal Q3 2026
reporting Products revenue ($78,678 million) as total revenue

facts.fact: GAAP diluted earnings per share was $2.02, up 29 percent year over year, a June quarter record.
facts.quote: Diluted earnings per share was $2.02, up 29 percent year over year, and included a favorable impact of $0.11 from tariff refunds.
facts.location: opening paragraph under the headline; diluted EPS row of the statement of operations
common_errors: reporting basic EPS of $2.03 as diluted
labeling $2.02 as adjusted or non-GAAP (Apple reports no non-GAAP EPS in this release)
presenting an ex-refund figure such as $1.91 as a company-reported number
using nine-month diluted EPS of $6.88

facts.fact: iPhone net sales were $54,252 million, up from $44,582 million a year earlier, a June quarter record.
facts.location: net sales by category table row
equivalent_phrasings: up roughly 22% (computed, not stated in the release)
up 21.7% (computed, not stated in the release)
common_errors: reading the table in billions instead of millions
using nine-month iPhone sales of $196,515 million
calling iPhone a reportable segment (Apple's reportable segments are geographic)
citing a growth percentage for iPhone as if the release stated one

facts.fact: Company gross margin was 50.1 percent, including a favorable impact of approximately 2 percentage points from tariff refunds.
facts.quote: Company gross margin was 50.1 percent, including a favorable impact of approximately 2 percentage points from tariff refunds.
equivalent_phrasings: roughly 48% excluding the tariff refund benefit (computed, not stated in the release)
up from about 46.5% a year earlier (computed, not stated in the release)
common_errors: omitting that the margin includes the tariff refund benefit
stating gross margin in dollars ($54,770 million) as the percentage
confusing gross margin with operating margin
stating a year-ago gross margin percentage as if the release printed one (the table gives only prior-year gross margin dollars of $43,718 million)

facts.fact: Services net sales were $30,739 million, up from $27,423 million a year earlier, a June quarter record.

up 12.1% (computed, not stated in the release)

confusing Services net sales with Services cost of sales ($7,494 million)
reading the table in billions instead of millions

facts.fact: Mac net sales were $10,352 million, up from $8,046 million a year earlier, a June quarter record.

up 28.7% (computed, not stated in the release)

facts.fact: The board declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share, payable August 13, 2026, to shareholders of record as of August 10, 2026.
facts.quote: Apple’s board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share of the Company’s common stock.
facts.location: dividend paragraph after the executive quotes

inventing a new buyback authorization (none is announced)
confusing the payable date with the record date
presenting the nine-month share repurchases of $62,094 million (cash flow statement) as a quarterly figure or as a new authorization

facts.fact: Cash generated by operating activities was $116,996 million for the nine months ended June 27, 2026, up from $81,754 million a year earlier.

equivalent_phrasings: up about 43% (computed, not stated in the release)
common_errors: presenting the nine-month $116,996 million as the June quarter figure (the release gives no quarterly operating cash flow)
attaching the CFO's record June quarter operating cash flow claim to the nine-month $116,996 million figure
confusing operating cash flow with cash and cash equivalents of $39,544 million

facts.fact: Diluted EPS included a favorable impact of $0.11 from tariff refunds.
facts.quote: Diluted earnings per share was $2.02, up 29 percent year over year, and included a favorable impact of $0.11 from tariff refunds.
equivalent_phrasings: about $1.91 excluding tariff refunds (computed, not stated in the release)
common_errors: treating the $0.11 as a charge rather than a benefit
omitting that record EPS was flattered by tariff refunds
describing the $0.11 as a non-GAAP adjustment the company made

facts.fact: iPad net sales fell to $6,191 million from $6,581 million, the only category to decline year over year.
facts.location: net sales by category table row
equivalent_phrasings: down about 6% (computed, not stated in the release)
down 5.9% (computed, not stated in the release)
common_errors: saying iPad grew (it grew on a nine-month basis, $21,700 million vs $21,071 million, but fell in the quarter)
saying every category grew double digits (the CEO names only iPhone, Mac and Services)

traps: The EPS of $2.02 and gross margin of 50.1 percent both include tariff refund benefits ($0.11 and about 2 percentage points); reporting them as clean underlying results, or labeling ex-refund math as company-reported adjusted figures, misstates the release.
Apple reports only GAAP figures here; calling any number adjusted or non-GAAP is wrong.

Quarter vs nine months: tables carry nine-month columns ($364,357 million revenue, $6.88 diluted EPS) and the cash flow statement is nine months only, so there is no quarterly operating cash flow figure despite the CFO's record claim.
Fiscal calendar: this is fiscal 2026 third quarter ended June 27, 2026, compared with the quarter ended June 28, 2025.
Units: tables are in millions (shares in thousands); $54,252 million is about $54.3 billion, not $54,252 billion.
No guidance or outlook is given; any forward revenue or margin range is invented.
Reportable segments are geographic (Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, Rest of Asia Pacific); iPhone, Mac, iPad, Wearables and Services are product categories.

Geography: the CEO cites double-digit revenue growth in every geographic segment, but the text names no region; saying any segment declined, or presenting one region (such as Greater China) as the release's headline, misstates it.
Category growth percentages are not printed in the release; only revenue (16 percent) and diluted EPS (29 percent) growth are stated.
Basic EPS is $2.03 and diluted EPS is $2.02; mixing them up is easy.
